Hello. I am afraid I cannot tell you much about my merchandise. I was hired by Ton to look after the shop at night. I can tell you that you would find a better deal during the daytime hours. Ton instructs me to charge more for nighttime service.
My armies have failed. . . how could this have happened?
You will pay, and pay dearly, for this.  The Claws will exterminate you.
This cannot be. . . I will return. . . somehow, in some way. . .
Avenge me, brothers! No mercy, no quarter!
shatters. Splinters of bone and foul dust taint the air.
gurgles an incomprehensible warcry as it sets upon you.
paws at the soil in anticipation, then charges full-bore directly at you!
It is good to see new customers here in Brownloe Bakery. but I am very busy right now. If you would like to purchase something. please speak with my wife. Pincia.
I abhor violence, but if you insist I will send you to Karana.
I'm sorry that it was necessary to kill you, but you left me little choice.
lumbers forth to attack, each ponderous footfall shaking the temple.
grasps at his throat as he chokes out a few final words, 'I foresaw this.  My death.  Our deaths.  We are all going to perish!'
The Cragbeast Queen roars in defiance. She staggers for a moment before her gargantuan form comes crashing to the sandy ground. The impact shakes the entire beach of Natimbi.

I am no warrior but you will pay!
None shall defile the realm of our master!
Where am I?
snaps at you.
My soul serves Innoruuk!
Puny creature, feel the might of the Kromrif as I crush you into mortar for our walls!

Yeah. hello. I'm Prak. co-owner of the Golden Rooster. If you're thirsty. we have some great imported ales at our bar. If you're looking for a little excitement. try your hand at a little King's Court. We aim to please. my friend.
